title: Russian high school taught moon landing hoax
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Russian high school taught moon landing hoax, about unspecified at Russia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: My friend who was from Russia said that in high school they were teaching that the moon landing was a hoax.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says a friend of his who grew up in Russia told him that in high school they were taught the American moon landing was faked. He shares it as an example of how countries can shape what their people believe about space.
